population: Explicitly nonclinical eligible adult recreational novice/intermediate hybrid athletes, offline synthetic only
principles: All future weeks are conditional proposals; actual response gates progression, never elapsed calendar alone
Program phases have goal-specific intents and exit criteria; no fixed optimal periodization claim
Start from self-reported currently tolerated complete prescriptions; unknown load or intensity is never invented
Novice modality uses only current R4 establishment recipes until actual response establishes additional scope
Preserve adequate plans and seek Pareto scheduling before necessary priority trade-offs
Session, week, phase and event are validated together; completed actuals and official plans are immutable
No load debt or compression after missed essential sessions; assess next essential stimulus and event
Progression considers only one known previously tolerated dose alternative per future week after repeated comparable compatible execution; no universal percentage increments
Strength may advance reps, load, sets or effort only through supplied familiar complete alternatives; no obligatory weight increase
Repeated incompatible actual response can select a supplied familiar lower dose; no diagnosis or automatic restoration
Hills, strides, threshold, faster intervals and event-specific tasks require explicit current familiar calibrated prescriptions; easy pace cannot establish them

Planned recovery transitions use supplied familiar recovery alternatives; deliberate event transition requires a complete athlete-supplied familiar race-week configuration, otherwise scoped unsupported
Observational associations can rank independently admissible same-dose arrangements; cannot create dose authority or establish causation
Operational evidence thresholds are conservative bookkeeping; not physiological laws
